thats a hard question.

First notice this ship is not currently in the game, the short answer is no, while far from any of the newer more powerful ships, this ship was considered useful as an aide battle ship due to low requirements and decent cargo, while the value of most ships is somewhat lower in the current server, i doubt these will be used as mats i consider them above MSC, MSSX, CSTS, MKW, TaiwanS and CV in the list of ships to use as mat.
